ALL THAT certain tract or parcel of land and premises lying, being and situate in Haddonfield  
Borough, Camden County, and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

BEGINNING at the intersection of the Southeasterly line of Redman Avenue (60.00 feet wide) with  
the Southwesterly line of Turley Avenue (20.00 feet wide, also known as Veterans Lane); thence

1) Along the Southwesterly line of Turley Avenue, South 44 degrees 49 minutes 50 seconds East, a  
distance of 140.00 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 2 and 3, Block 129, Tax Map;  
thence

2) Along said division line, South 45 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds West, a distance of 100.00 feet  
to an angle point; thence

3) Continuing along said division line, North 44 degrees 49 minutes 50 seconds West, a distance of  
140.00 feet to a point in the Southeasterly line of Redman Avenue; thence

4) Along the Southwesterly line of Redman Avenue, North 45 degrees 00 minutes 00 seconds East, a  
distance of 100.00 feet to the point and place of beginning.

The foregoing description has been drawn in accordance with a survey made by Walter H.  
Macnamara Assoc., Inc. Professional Land Surveyors, dated July 31, 2023.

FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY:  
BEING premises No. 20 E. Redman Ave.

BEING Tax Block: 129, Tax Lot: 2
